cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've put your umbrella back in the stand. You'll want it for work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it wet? It hasn't rained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I gave it a rinse. I'll dry the handle before you go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's pondweed caught in the spokes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it needs another rinse. Have breakfast; I'll get it back in the stand properly this time.

mechanism: A restores a suspiciously wet umbrella while using corrective cleaning expertise to explain away evidence of its unmentioned misuse.
confusable: Helpful Culprit investigates blame; this A focuses on returning the object to normal while keeping its prior use undisclosed.
comparison: Plate alternative replaces a matching set after an obvious substitute; umbrella alternative removes revealing contamination during claimed maintenance.
seedUse: Umbrella stand, dry weather and pondweed derive from D37-a; S03 makes restoration a precise cleaning procedure that displaces questions about cause.
